body.text: Starting this month, please transfer invoice payments to our new bank account below. Ignore the old account.
The invoice is due tomorrow. Please process it right away so the delivery is not delayed.

explanation: This vendor usually uses sinarjaya.test, but this email comes from sinarjaya-pembayaran.test and asks to switch bank accounts. A change of bank account must be confirmed through the vendor's official phone number, not by email.
hints: PT Sinar Jaya's usual domain is sinarjaya.test. Does it match this sender?
A request to switch bank accounts plus time pressure is a dangerous combination.
